participant_1.name: Jake
participant_1.personality: Easygoing and friendly, enjoys making connections with others.
participant_1.background: I coach little league baseball. I have five sons. Coffee is my preferred beverage. I drive a mini van. I also like a glass of wine in the evenings.

participant_2.name: Evelyn
participant_2.personality: Vivacious and spirited, loves life and enjoys reminiscing about the past.
participant_2.background: I am 100 years old. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. I am very strong for my age. I feel like I might live forever. I remember when nobody had a television.
